name: Mix with the Masters - Jack Antonoff producing 'Please Please Please' by Sabrina Carpenter
original_name: Mix with the Masters - Jack Antonoff producing 'Please Please Please' by Sabrina Carpenter
overview: Jack heads back into the studio to reveal the creative process behind Sabrina Carpenter’s extraordinary hit single, ‘Please Please Please’. The visionary producer breaks down his unconventional approach to making records and unveils how he helped craft a bold, theatrical arrangement that soared to the top of the charts.
